children.title: Cycle 68 · Revising the Abandonment Hypothesis and Proposing an Empirical Test

detail.title: Revising the Abandonment Hypothesis and Proposing an Empirical Test
detail.summary: Based on the inconclusive measurement from our pilot experiment (e-abandonment-pilot-001) regarding rational question abandonment, we propose a revised hypothesis and follow-up experiment to more precisely examine epistemic return thresholds and sunk cost effects.
